8.17.1.1. iLock_Geography.geo2pispec.PiSPECGenerator.__init__¶

PiSPECGenerator.__init__(predicateManager, importedLayout=False, attributeNameMap=None)¶

Constructor.

Parameters:
  • predicateManager (PredicateManager) – A predicate manager containing registered geo predicates.
  • importedLayout (bool) – If False, gui association will be set to the railyard objects from the layout editor.
  • attributeNameMap (dict(string,string)?) – A map from attributes of geo objects to attributes of PiSPEC objects. Note that the attributes of PiSPEC objects must be declared from GeneratorAPI before.
